articleTitle: Improved Traffic Sign Detection Algorithm for YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traffic sign detection is an integral part of advanced assisted driving systems and intelligent transportation systems. Based on the TT100K dataset, this paper conducts a study on the improved YOLOv5s traffic sign detection algorithm. Firstly, to address the problem of low detection accuracy due to unbalanced sample size among different categories in the TT100K dataset, the replacement method, the paste method and the conventional data expansion method were successively used on the dataset, resulting in an increase in traffic sign detection accuracy from 80.9% to 91.2%. In order to further improve the application value of the traffic sign detection algorithm, this paper reduces the downsampling layer of the backbone in YOLOv5s to obtain a detection head with higher resolution, thus getting the model YOLOv5s-strong, whose detection accuracy is 4.9% higher than YOLOv5s. Even surpasses the detection accuracy and inference time of YOLOv7 with less number of parameters and calculations

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method of Capacitor Voltage Transformer based on Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Capacitor voltage transformer (CVT) is an important part of electric energy metering device. If the fault can not be located in time and repaired, it will cause serious consequences. At present, it is usually judged by manual to check the cause of the fault, which consumes a lot of manpower and material resources and has low efficiency. In this paper, an automatic intelligent diagnosis method for CVT fault causes is proposed. A neural network model based on WHO-RNN architecture is designed. The model optimizes the parameters by Wild Horse Optimizer(WHO). Then the recurrent neural network(RNN) model is trained and used for prediction to realize the deep mining of historical data information. It can intelligently judge the cause of CVT fault through online data, and judge the fault location of CVT as early as possible. The simulation results show that the accuracy of this method is about 93%, which is significantly higher than that of ordinary RNN neural network, and meets the accuracy requirements of CVT fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Enhanced DeepLabv3+ for PolSAR image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) is an advanced remote sensing technology that can provide radar images with polarimetric information. The research of PolSAR image classification algorithm has always been one of the hot spots and difficulties in SAR remote sensing image processing. Deep learning algorithms usually require a large amount of training data to achieve a good classification effect. However, in the field of PolSAR image classification, the available data set is relatively small due to the complexity of data acquisition and processing. In order to improve the effectiveness of deep learning algorithm in PolSAR image classification. In this chapter, the idea of SKNet unit is integrated into DeepLabV3+network, and a SK_ ASPP unit is proposed, which can adaptively learn feature weights, so as to better extract features related to classification tasks. Experimental results on Flevoland data sets show that the network has better accuracy, overall accuracy (OA) and Kappa accuracy than the original DeepLabv3+.

articleTitle: Research on fusion model of BERT and CNN-BiLSTM for short text classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With respect to short texts with high information content, unstructured and non-standard, a text classification model (BERT-CNN-BiLSTM) based on the fusion of BERT model and BiLSTM network with convolutional neural network is proposed. To improve data processing efficiency and classification precision, word vectors are trained in BERT and used as the embedding layer of the model. The embedding layer is utilized to retain semantic information and the semantic representation of words is enhanced. CNN is applied to extract the local semantics of text. Meanwhile, gated linear unit (GLU) is used to optimise the CNN, and gradient dispersion is reduced. BiLSTM is designed to acquire contextual information about the text. Text classification is better implemented. The experimental results show that better results are obtained by BERT training data as word vectors. The BERT-CNN-BiLSTM has significantly improved in terms of classification precision, recall and F1 than the CNN, the BERT-CNN, et al. Precision, recall and F1 values are improved by at least 1.44%, 1.66% and 1.69%, respectively.

articleTitle: Range Doppler Algorithm for Wide-beam Multi-Receiver Synthetic Aperture Sonar Considering Differential Range Curvature
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that existing imaging algorithms under wide beam conditions only consider the relative range offset between different receivers, ignoring differential range curvature, resulting in poor imaging quality under wide beam conditions, this paper proposes a range Doppler imaging algorithm for synthetic aperture sonar with multiple receivers that considers differential range curvature. Firstly, Signals from different receivers are corrected to the central reference receiver in the range Doppler domain, and spectrum aliasing is removed through coherent superposition. The multiple receiver signal is equivalent to a monostatic wide beam signal. Then, the two-dimensional spectrum of the equivalent wide beam signal is obtained through series inversion. Only one imaging process is required for the wide beam signal to obtain imaging results, taking into account imaging quality and efficiency. Computer simulation experiments have proved the superiority of our method.

articleTitle: Based on scale constraint K-means underwater target highlights clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: When clustering multi-target highlights in an underwater battlefield environment, the traditional K-means algorithm cannot be used because of unknowing the priori information on the number of targets. For problem with scale constraint, this algorithm uses the scale constraint to obtain the number of clusters. This paper establishes the simulation environment of the underwater battlefield, and proposes a simulation highlights model of submarine and decoy suitable for the universality verification of the algorithm. Simulation test results show that under the condition of random dense placement of up to 10 targets and acoustic decoys in the limited sea space, the correct rate of cluster number K is not less than 93.02%, and the correct rate can reach more than 99.92% considering the practical application conditions such as submarine navigation safety and decoy tactical usage, indicating that the algorithm has higher engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on Joint Estimation Algorithm of Intelligent Vehicle Mass and Road Grade
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Accurate estimation of vehicle mass and road grade is of great significance for vehicle dynamics, safety, comfort and economy. For intelligent vehicles, the traditional methods use less data, and the estimated vehicle pitch angle is directly used as the road grade, so their accuracy is limited, especially in road grade estimation. Therefore, a joint estimation algorithm of intelligent vehicle mass and road grade is proposed. Firstly, the unscented kalman filter is used to estimate the vehicle pitch angle, and uses the derived vehicle pitch angle-road grade relation to calculate the road grade. Then, the vehicle mass is estimated by the vehicle longitudinal dynamics model. Finally, the estimated values of vehicle mass and road grade are cross-iterated. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, a simulation experiment platform was built by using Carsim and Matlab/Simulink software. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has fast convergence speed, high accuracy and good stability.

articleTitle: Crowd Counting Study Based on Low Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the uniformity of data brightness, we propose a crowd counting architecture based on low-light image enhancement in this research. Mainly, a module with curve estimation is added to the architecture, the RGB and T images in the RGBT-CC dataset are enhanced at the light level. The effective channel attention mechanism and exposure control loss are added to suppress low-light/dark areas while reducing background noise. Based on the BL as the backbone, a lot of experiments are conducted. The results show that the data enhancement at the light level of the dataset can improve the illumination uniformity and reduce crowd counting error, proving that the model has higher accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle charging strategy under time-of-use electricity price mechanism based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to balance the load of the power grid, maintain the safe and stable operation of the power grid, and reduce the charging cost of electric vehicle users, this paper, based on the multi-objective multi-objective optimization model of time-of-use electricity price, takes the charging time of electric vehicle as the optimization variable, takes the minimum charging cost of electric vehicle and the minimum peak-valley difference of the power grid as the optimization objective. And establishes the charging optimization model of electric vehicle under the consideration of various constraints such as power flow. Through the solution of particle swarm optimization method. It is proved that the time-of-use tariff charging strategy can not only reduce the charging cost of electric vehicle users. But also play a role of “peak shaving and valley filling” for the power grid. The strategy proposed in this paper can be well applied in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Network Traffic Monitoring Based on Time Series Prediction with Information Theoretic Entropy Value Judgment and Improved Moving Average Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Web traffic monitoring is of great importance in today's rapidly evolving Internet. Currently, existing web traffic monitoring models rely on huge data sets for analysis and prediction, and small and micro websites do not have huge data sets, which is not conducive to their development planning and commercialisation. This paper proposes a time series prediction method for web traffic monitoring based on information theoretic entropy evaluation and improved moving average method, which does not require a huge initial data set and ensures the accuracy of data prediction through entropy evaluation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Approximation Strategy to Reduce Approximation Error in Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Approximation error exists in the reinforcement learning method which is based on the action-value. In this paper, we propose an adaptive approximation strategy to reduce this error. The motivation is that the approximation way should adapt to the current training. For every period of the training time step, the adaptive approximation strategy tests the current learned policy to judge whether the current approximation is overestimated or underestimated. Then according to the result of the judgment, it adjusts the approximation way to adapt the current training by changing the target of action-value to mitigate the error. The experiments illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Comparison of text sentiment analysis based on traditional machine learning and deep learning methods
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to the rapid development and widespread use of Internet technology, the Internet has provided a convenient platform for individuals to express their emotions and view comments on microblogs. The collection of user feedback has resulted in a vast amount of data resources, including information on public sentiment. Such data is crucial for the platform's operation and direction, making sentiment analysis of these data sources important for social development. In this paper, we utilize various methods, such as support vector machine (SVM) and recurrent neural network (RNN), including Bayesian, CNN, LSTM, BERT, among others, to analyze the sentiment of online commentary text represented quantitatively as vectors. We evaluate the performance of each model based on accuracy, recall, and F1 score. Our experimental results demonstrate that Bert+CNN outperforms other models in terms of accuracy, recall, and F1 verification. Additionally, we find that LSTM achieves the highest recall, while GRU exhibits the highest F1 score.

articleTitle: TICCA - A Co-attention Network for Multimodal Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The way people consuming news changed from traditional news papers to social media like Weibo and Twitter with the development of information technology, which facilitates the propagation of fake news. Several studies have made great contributions to fake news detection with multimodal contents, but the relationship between news contents and user comments is not fully exploited. In this work, we propose a fake news detection method named TICCA (Text, Images, Comments Co-Attention) using not only contents including news text and news images but also user comments, the news images features and news text features are fused by text-image co-attention, the correlation between news text and user comments is extracted by text-comment co-attention, the correlation between news images and user comments is extracted by comment-image co-attention. The experimental results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A novel Load allocation policy for reliability improvement of load-sharing systems with two continuously degrading components
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Frequently used to improve system reliability, load-sharing mechanism has been widely applied to many engineering practices. In a load-sharing system, the components bear the whole load together, and the load of a failed component will be allocated to the surviving components, which will surely affect their reliability. The traditional equal load-sharing policy is the most popular allocation policy. However, due to heterogeneity of unit individual attributes and working environment, components of a load-sharing system will be in different degradation states and reliability levels. Confronted with this problem, this paper proposes a novel load allocation policy for reliability improvement of load-sharing systems. The components are subject to continuous degradation, which can be modelled by Wiener process. Based on their periodically inspected degradation states, the whole load will be allocated to the components according to their current and predictive degradation states. Numerical studies are conducted under different degradation model parameters. Compared with the traditional equal load allocation policy, the proposed policy can lead to effective and robust reliability improvement.

articleTitle: Secrecy Performance Analysis for Hybrid Satellite-UWOC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the expansion of human activities into the ocean, there is an urgent need for information transmission technology with higher data rates and more security. On the other hand, satellite communication plays an important role in the maritime area, but is also vulnerable to eavesdropping because of its broadcast nature. Therefore, in this study, the physical-layer security for a hybrid satellite and underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) system is considered. Specifically, a satellite source first broadcasts information to an overwater relay via an RF link, and then the relay converts the electrical signal to an optical one and transmits it to an underwater destination via a UWOC link, while an eavesdropper is overhearing this transmission. We derived the closed-form expressions for several system performance metrics, i.e., secrecy outage probability (SOP), and average secrecy capacity (ASC). Finally, Monte-Carlo simulations verify the accuracy of those results.

articleTitle: Automatic Front-end Code Generation from image Via Multi-Head Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Code generation from Graphical User Interface (GUI) screenshots is a challenging task in machine learning. Existing methods (e.g., Pix2code) can handle simple datasets well but struggle with complex datasets requiring hundreds of code tokens. This paper proposes a novel method for generating front-end code based on multi-head attention. Our method uses a special technique called multi-head attention to analyze a GUI screenshot's feature vector, generate the code tokens, and link the analysis and generation processes. This architecture gives our method a significant advantage over similar models in terms of effectiveness. We conduct experiments on two types of datasets: Pix2code datasets and our own datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves the best performance among existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Adjustment of Bearings-only passive location of UAV Based on Computational geometry
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model is established to study the bearings-only passive positioning adjustment of a circular formation of UAVs. Firstly, in order to establish the bearings-only passive location equation of UAV under ideal conditions and to keep the electromagnetic silence as much as possible, this paper uses the computational geometry method. The polar coordinates of the passive receiver under ideal conditions are obtained by taking a fixed angle quadrilateral as the basic model and using the trigonometric function formula. Secondly, when there is a slight deviation in the initial position of the UAV, in this paper, a method is proposed based on the uniform distribution of the UAV and the constant adjustment of the angle information, and using the ideal model equation, a dual-optimization model of the circle angle and distance is established. Finally, through the physical simulation of the mathematical model with MATLAB software, the convergence of the model can be obtained.

articleTitle: QR code images fast blind deblurring based on specific symbol prior and L2 norm minimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Recently QR code has been widely used and has made great convenience to our daily life. However, the degradation of QR code images will make them difficult to be recognized and decoded. In the meantime, we find there are some problems when the existing excellent deblurring algorithms are applied to the QR code images. First, the restored over-sharpened edges may destroy the ratio of specific symbol in images, which will lead to the failure of decoding. Second, these methods are time-consuming and impractical to be directly used. To solve these problems, a model based on <tex>$L_{2}$</tex> norm is proposed to avoid over-sharpened edges, and then the gray level and gradient features of QR code are utilized to optimize it. Besides, based on the specific symbol prior, we introduce an evaluation mechanism to achieve fast deblurring. The experimental results show that our method has better performance than other state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Gas emergence prediction based on a combination of improved dung beetle optimizer algorithm and temporal convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to better analyze and process the coal mine gas outflow data, the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) is proposed to decompose the gas outflow sequence and construct the time convolution network (TCN) model for each component separately. The relevant hyperparameters of the TCN model are optimally found using the Improved Dung Beetle optimizer (IDBO) algorithm, and the predicted output values of each component are superimposed to obtain the final predicted value of gas outflow. The proposed CEEMDAN-IDBO-TCN combined prediction method can provide high accuracy gas outflow prediction.

articleTitle: A Motion Control Method For Agent Based On Dyna-Q Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Motion control, i.e. the path planning, in the unknown environment of the agent is a general interest for scholars and how to increase the efficiency of motion control is the most important point. For that, this paper puts forward a motion control method based on Dyna-Q algorithm. The motion control steps with reinforcement learning algorithm is designed and for increase the learning efficiency, a Dyna-Q framework is utilized. The experiment results show that, the method this paper proposed has more fast convergence efficiency and is more suitable for the unknown and dynamic environment to the compared methods.

articleTitle: 3D Point Cloud Segmentation Algorithm Based on Improved Region Growing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Point cloud segmentation is the key link of point cloud data processing, which can provide important information for subsequent surface reconstruction and feature extraction. In the point cloud segmentation algorithm based on regional growth, the selection strategy of seed points and the judgment basis of growth or not are the two factors that have the greatest influence on the segmentation effect. In this paper, the point with the smallest curvature is used as the seed point. According to the density of the point cloud and the number of points fitting the surface adaptively, the normal vector of each point on the surface of the point cloud is calculated. Then, by calculating the mean and standard deviation of the angle difference between the normal vectors of the points in the neighborhood of various sub-points, the confidence interval is set as the condition of regional growth. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the effect of point cloud segmentation obviously compared with the traditional region growing algorithm.

articleTitle: A Time Series Prediction Algorithm Based on BiLSTM and Prophet Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduce BiLSTM-Prophet, a successor to Facebook Prophet, which set an industry standard for explainable and user-friendly forecasting frameworks. with the increase of time series complexity, it is still a challenging task to improve the prediction accuracy of time series. We view Prophet as a precursor to such a solution. However, for some complex time series, the Prophet is too idealistic, hybrid solutions are needed to bridge the gap between classical methods and neural network models. Experiments with real data in enterprise BI business demonstrate that the prediction accuracy of the BiLSTM-Prophet proposed in this paper is significantly better than that of other traditional models.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Bus-Stop Boards System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To improve the intelligence of urban public transportation management and tackle the pain points of public transportation for urban residents, a multi-functional intelligent bus stop system is proposed and implemented in this paper. The system includes two main functions: dynamic information service of buses and multimedia video broadcasting. The system improves the user experience during waiting time effectively. This paper discusses the background and technical architecture of the system in detail. The results indicate that the system fulfils the design requirements. It offers a dynamic intercommunication approach to meet the communication needs of buses. The intelligent bus stop boards display location and arrival time of buses. It should be noted that the device provides analysis results of bus route that reduce waiting time of passengers.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Strategy of Heterogeneous Computing Chip Based on Improved Common Origin Grey Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Heterogeneous computing chips are widely used in AI, cloud computing and other fields based on their high performance computing capability, scalability, and high utilization of computing resources. However, there are relatively few researches based on the performance evaluation of heterogeneous computing chips at present, and many companies and individuals have many uncertainties in the convenience of selecting heterogeneous chips. In response to the above problems, this paper constructs a heterogeneous computing evaluation index system based on chip network performance, business support capability, security, virtualization and other dimensions, and then proposes a heterogeneous chip evaluation method based on hybrid cross-weighting and improved co-origin grey clustering, and proposed a hybrid cross-weighting method based on the variation coefficient order relationship method. At the same time, in view of the inaccuracy of the gray class crossing and the rate change of membership of the common origin clustering function, the function interval and function form of the common origin gray clustering are modified to make the evaluation result more reasonable and authentic.

articleTitle: Two-way Prototypical Network Based on Word Embedding Mixup for Few-shot Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The task of few-shot event detection is to identify trigger words and their associated event types in text, when only a limited amount of labeled samples are available. Many existing methods use meta-learning techniques to address this issue by training a model to quickly adapt to new types. However, these approaches struggle to learn discriminative features in low-resource scenarios. To address this limitation, we consider utilizing the labeled samples in the test set as the target set and propose a two-way prototypical network model that leverages both the target set and the training set, incorporating the word embedding mixup technique to enhance its performance. Additionally, to prevent trigger word overfitting, we incorporate noise perturbations and adversarial learning during training. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art methods with an improvement of 2.59%, 7.02%, 4.36%, and 9.59% in the 5-way 5-shot, 5-way 10-shot, 10-way 5-shot, and 10-way 10-shot settings, respectively, on the benchmark dataset FewEvent in terms of F1 score.

articleTitle: Recognition and Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Deep Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a common Neurodegeneration that can be clinically diagnosed on the basis of neuroimaging. Based on the deep convolution network, this paper analyzes the MRI images to identify and classify Alzheimer's disease. By establishing a depth network model, the accuracy of the training set and the test set, as well as the comparison images of the test values and the real values, therefore, it is of great significance to improve the clinical diagnostic efficiency and early prediction accuracy of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Segmentation of metastatic lesions on bone scan images based on improved UNet3+ network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Automatic segmentation of bone metastases in low resolution SPECT bone scan images has an extensive clinical application. In this paper, we propose an improved UNet3+ network incorporating an attention mechanism to realize automatic segmentation of bone metastatic lesions. Firstly, by improving the full-scale deep supervision module to reduce the semantic gap between low-level and high-level features during feature fusion, which helps to obtain more refined segmentation results. Secondly, the segmentation performance of the model is further improved by adding an attention module to the network. Finally, the paper uses a group of clinical SPECT images to evaluate the custom segmentation model on a test sample of the original dataset with values of 0.6433, 0.6120, and 0.6833 for DSC, CPA, and Recall, respectively. The effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper has been demonstrated through experimental comparisons with several similar models.

articleTitle: Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for Solving the Dynamic Scheduling Problem of Aircraft Assembly Line under Material Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The aircraft assembly process has extremely high requirements on the punctuality of material supply, and the delay of materials often makes the formwork assembly plan unfeasible, affecting the normal progress of the aircraft assembly project. In order to effectively solve the problem of dynamic scheduling of the aircraft assembly line due to material delay, a mathematical model is established using the material supply delay as the driving event of reactive scheduling, and a hybrid genetic algorithm is designed to solve the problem. The algorithm is embedded with tabu search to enhance the local search ability. Extensive tests and comparative experiments show that HGA is an efficient algorithm.

articleTitle: Dual-stream architecture and improved action recognition based on 3D convolutional neural network fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to the rich content of video data and the excessive parameters of 3D convolutional networks, how to reduce the difficulty of parameter tuning and reduce the training time is a difficult problem in action recognition. To solve these difficulties, a new action recognition algorithm based on dual-stream architecture and improved three-dimensional convolutional aggregation is proposed. The network structure of the 3D convolution kernel is split into two types of convolution kernels, spatial flow and time flow, and the data flow is fused based on the dual-stream network, and the residual network is introduced for optimization. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, it is verified on the large public behavior dataset UCF101. Experimental results show that the algorithm has good spatiotemporal feature modeling ability, which effectively improves the accuracy of action recognition while shortening the training time.

articleTitle: Extraction of Ballistocardiogram Signal and Respiratory Signal based on WOA-VMD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The acquisition of ballistocardiogram (BCG) signals during sleeping always presents all kinds of high-frequency noise, which causes the problem to extract effective signals. This article proposes a new method to extract heartbeat and respiration signals by combining the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) and variational mode decomposition (VMD). Firstly, the sample entropy and energy difference ratio are used as the fitness function of WOA to optimize the penalty factor in the variational mode decomposition a and the number of decomposition layers K;Then the original signal was decomposed into multiple modal components (IMF) by optimized VMD; Finally, respiration and heartbeat signals were reconstructed, and their frequencies got calculated. Compared with the experimental results of empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), the average respiratory rate error obtained by this algorithm is 0.097 and 0.013 lower than EMD and EEMD respectively, and the average heart rate error is 0.03 and 0.006 lower than EMD and EEMD respectively, it is proved that the algorithm can extract breath and heartbeat signals more effectively and accurately.

articleTitle: Robot planning and control method based on improved time elastic band algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: For the planning and control system of differential mobile robots, the traditional time elastic band (TEB) algorithm has a long obstacle detection time and cannot complete dynamic planning in complex environments. At the same time, the control quantity calculated by TEB based on the trajectory point sequence difference has a jump, which results in poor control effect and unstable steering. By simplifying complex obstacles with RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) algorithm, the collision detection time can be reduced and the algorithm computation can be reduced. At the same time, based on the optimal preview strategy, a nonlinear proportional function of tracking error is defined to recalculate the robot control quantity, so as to reduce the jump and make the operation control more stable. Finally, a robot navigation system based on ROS is built for experiments. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the method and improve the real-time performance and reliability of differential robot planning and control.

articleTitle: An Asynchronous Power Optimization Method for Microprocessor Based on The Event-Matching Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the high power consumption caused by clock circuits in the synchronous processor, this paper proposed an asynchronous power optimization method based on the event-matching mechanism. It first partitioned events based on the processor behavior. Secondly, it designed the asynchronous control path based on the event-matching mechanism. Finally, it used the asynchronous control path instead of the clock circuit to drive the processor. The verification results based on this method show that the total power of the target processor is reduced by 52 % on Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA, and the total power is reduced by 87% under the 180nm CMOS technology. Furthermore, this method has the best performance per watt compared with other related works.

articleTitle: Automatic detection of green litchi based on YOLOV3, YOLOV4, YOLOV5-S and YOLOV5-X deep learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The accurate detection of green litchi is one of the important means of litchi plantation, and plays an important role in disease and insect protection and yield estimation. Selecting models that already exist on the market is not only convenient and fast, but also saves costs. In this experiment, YOLOV3, YOLOV 4, YOLOV5-S and YOLOV5-X of YOLO series were used to detect green litchi in the natural environment, and the most suitable model for detection was obtained through comparison and analysis. The experimental results show that the model detection effect of YOLOV5 is the best, and the detection speed of YOLOV5-S model is the fastest. The average accuracy of YOLOV5-X is 0.998, the average accuracy of FPS is 11.13, the average accuracy of YOLOV5-S is 0.993, and the average accuracy of FPS is 47.16. To sum up, YOLOV5-S model is more suitable for detecting green litchi in natural environment because of its fast speed and relatively high accuracy.

articleTitle: Architecture Research of Novel Digital Intelligent Substation System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper, taking substation as an example, studies the novel digital intelligent substation system. Firstly, the concept of this substation system is proposed, and its construction objective is introduced. Furthermore, its functional framework is clarified, and the four core characteristics of intelligent brain are pointed out, thus providing the guiding ideology for the application of top-level intelligent business in substation. Finally, the application prospect of the novel digital intelligent substation system is discussed, which provides a reference research idea for the further development of this professional field.

articleTitle: Dynamic detection method for Android terminal malware based on Native layer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The current traditional malware detection methods mainly obtain the characteristics of malware by analyzing the static file structure and binary byte code of the software, which leads to poor detection due to the lack of fusion processing of the characteristics. In this regard, we propose a dynamic detection method for Android terminal malware based on Native layer. The APK installation package of the Android application is parsed, and the dex file and Native library file are fused and mapped into a three-channel visual RGB color image, and the malware features are extracted and fused to achieve dynamic detection of malware. In the experiments, the detection performance of the proposed method is verified. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a larger ROC curve area and has a more desirable detection performance when malware is detected by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive model predictive control for trajectory tracking of Mecanum mobile robots
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the trajectory tracking effect of the omnidirectional mobile robot, a model predictive controller optimized by improved genetic algorithm is designed according to the kinematic model of Mecanum wheel; considering the mechanical constraints and speed constraints of the omnidirectional mobile robot, and considering the changes of the curvature of the tracking trajectory. The time domain parameters of the controller are adaptively adjusted, and the improved control algorithm is simulated and verified in Matlab. The results show that the proposed model predictive control method with adaptive time-domain parameters has higher accuracy for the given trajectory tracking effect.

articleTitle: Human Behavior Recognition for Substation Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the field of substation operation and maintenance, recognizing the behaviors of substation operation and maintenance personnel is crucial for maintaining the safe operation of the power grid and ensuring the safety of workers. To enhance the accuracy of human behavior recognition in substation operation and maintenance, this paper proposes an ECA-MSG3D algorithm model for human behavior recognition of work apparatus based on the Multi-Scale Pointwise Convolutional Neural Network for 3D Object Detection (MSG3D) model. The MSG3D module, which utilizes a multi-scale aggregation scheme for unified spatiotemporal graph convolution, is used for feature learning across time and space. Then, channel features are learned through the efficient channel attention (ECA) module, and the final action is obtained through global average pooling with the softmax classifier. Results show that the ECA-MSG3D model with the ECA attention module outperforms the MSG3D model with other attention modules, achieving 89.06% and 89.26% accuracy and precision on the NTU RGB+D 60 Skeleton dataset. This model provides a highly accurate human behavior recognition method for substation operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: GEP Algorithm-based Optimization Method for PCs Production Scheduling under Due Date Variation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Production scheduling plays a critical role in the on-time delivery of precast components (PCs) during the assembly of prefabricated construction. However, previous studies focused less on considering the changing scenarios during production process. And existing models are not adequate for dynamic environments where construction projects may have due dates change in actual PCs demand that occur due to on-site assembly schedules. As a direct experience, dispatching rules are suitable for solving complex scheduling problems, but existing manually configured scheduling rules are not guaranteed to be universal across multiple scenarios. The paper combines discrete-time simulation methods to establish a due date variation response model and by using dynamic scheduling rules constructed by Gene Expression Programming (GEP) algorithm to cope with multiple due date variation scenarios and achieve dynamic production planning. The effectiveness of the model and the superiority of the algorithm are tested by a real case. 25.8% and 7.5% cost savings can be achieved by comparison to no response and other existing excellent dispatching rules, respectively. The results show that the method can effectively address the occurrence of due dates variations and enhance the dynamic precast production management.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy License Plate Image Processing Technology Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, the criminal digital image processing technology is becoming more and more important in the public security business, especially the static fuzzy license plate processing technology. It is particularly important to identify the vehicle used by the suspect after the hit-and-run, the vehicle used by the suspect before and after the crime in the theft case and the vehicle used to transport the drug in the drug case. Paper focuses on using MATLAB how to deal with fuzzy plates allow investigators to identify the license plate content of Chinese characters, Numbers and letters, allow investigators to identify the vehicle's license plate number, determine the relevant vehicle information, locking the vehicles, and then to carry out relevant investigation activities, use a combination of theory and the software for processing images, Finally achieve the desired results.

articleTitle: Construction and prediction of a new learning model based on ARIMA algorithm1
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: At present, in the era of increasingly updated digital tools and resources, the effective design and implementation of learning systems is the key to improving the quality of learning services. The purpose of this paper is to obtain the comprehensive and objective real needs of users through the existing user learning data, make full use of the real-time user online behavior data to obtain the real “ideas” and potential needs of users, and then design the next stage learning system suitable for the designated users. First of all, the article transforms user characteristics into data that can be designed and calculated by collecting information such as behavior big data, and learner information and mapping the relationship between system measurement indicators. Then, the ARIMA time series prediction algorithm is used to predict the user's learning content in the next stage by collecting and calculating the user's characteristics based on the user's historical behavior data. Finally, through the prediction of the user's behavior, complete the design of the user's next stage learning system as a data-driven learning system with output results, and carry out case practice. The research shows that the system calculated and iterated by the ARIMA algorithm has been significantly improved in terms of software efficiency and other aspects, and the data-driven learning system design framework has a significant role in improving the overall needs of users and learning efficiency.

articleTitle: 3D Descriptor of Objects in a Scene based on the Average Depth of Point Cloud Images
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the field of machine vision, 3D point cloud data contains rich and comprehensive spatial information, and local feature descriptors based on 3D point cloud data play an important role for 3D object recognition tasks. In this paper, a new local surface descriptor is designed based on a stable local reference frame. First, the key points of the point cloud data are extracted, and the CA (Component Analysis) method is applied to obtain three vectors orthogonal to each other for the key points and their local domain points, and the ambiguity of the vector direction is eliminated according to the projection of the domain points on the plane formed by the vectors, and a stable, unambiguous and repeatable local reference frame. Then, based on this reference frame, the domain of key points is specified, and the points in the domain are projected onto each of the three planes, and the depth information of the local surface is computed based on this frame, so that the average depth information of the local points is encoded into a compact histogram under multiple views. Finally, it is shown experimentally that our Point Average Depth (PAD)descriptors has descriptive and reproducible, and achieve good performance in tests on the University of Western Australia (UWA) dataset and the self-collection dataset.

articleTitle: ESSNet: Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Semantic segmentation is widely used in fields such as self-driving, robot navigation and augmented virtual reality, which has extremely high requirements for the real-time reasoning and accurate segmentation of the network. Recently, semantic segmentation has made great progress in segmentation accuracy, but little attention has been paid to real-time reasoning. Therefore, it makes sense to propose a network to balance accuracy and real-time reasoning. In this paper, we propose a lightweight semantic segmentation network with Multiple Correction Confusion Mechanism (MCCM) and Lightweight Attention Mechanisms (LAM), named Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network (ESSNet). MCCM selectively incorporates low-level feature to make the network segmentation contour clearer. LAM effectively captures the context information, making the feature representation more abundant. In general, different scale features confusion, and efficient attention mechanisms are adopted by LCANet to significantly improve its performance. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the network, we conducted experiments on the Cityscapes and CamVid datasets, and obtained MIOU of 68.7<sup>%</sup> and 74.8%, respectively, which is comparable to the state-of-the-art methods under the same experimental settings. In addition, on a single Titan RTX card, the network reached a forward reasoning speed of 136.4 FPS (480x480x3 image resolution).

articleTitle: Airflow Concentration Sensing for Pulverized Coal: System design and Validation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Conventional concentration sensors have severe limitations in terms of detection accuracy and information acquisition. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a novel microwave-based detection system with a sensor structure of 16-electrode ring sensor that can alternate between transmitting and receiving states via a switch matrix. The system can effectively detect the concentration of pulverized coal under complex coal airflow conditions, greatly enhancing the accuracy of concentration parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the system can accurately classify concentrations of 0.2, 0.5, and 0.8 (kg/kg) of pulverized coal using a concentration classification algorithm based on an support vector machine(SVM) model. Furthermore, the study highlights the significance of using more electrodes as it significantly improves the accuracy of measurement results.

articleTitle: Effective Verifiable Index Structure for High Contention Workload
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Cloud storage systems have become a common data storage scheme. The most immediate problem is that the cloud service provider is not trusted, so certain measures must be taken to ensure the reliability of the data. In addition, when the system is in a highly concurrent scenario, the verification may affect the performance due to read/write conflicts, so this paper proposes a verifiable index structure Merkle Parallel Tree in the high-concurrency scenario, which solves the problem of read/write conflicts, effectively improves system performance, and supports query verification of historical versions of data.

articleTitle: Encrypted Traffic Classification Model Based on SwinT-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the network, the proportion of encrypted traffic in the network is increasing, which brings great challenges to traffic classification. The traditional encrypted traffic classification algorithm extracts the port number of the traffic or the load information of the traffic packet for feature matching, which has no effect in the current encrypted traffic. The encrypted traffic classification algorithm based on machine learning especially relies on the features extracted by professionals for encrypted traffic, which is inefficient and has low accuracy. And, The accuracy and overall performance of existing deep learning methods also need to be improved. Therefore, in order to improve the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification, this paper proposes an encrypted traffic classification method based on deep learning, which tries to combine the core modules of CNN and Swin Transformer with the encrypted traffic classification model to realize the identification of the application type of encrypted traffic. Among them, the CNN module is able to capture the local spatial information characteristics of encrypted traffic data. The multi-head attention mechanism of Swin Transformer can capture global information about the association between attributes of the data. The model is tested on the public ISCX VPN-nonVPN encryption dataset to evaluate the performance of the proposed model. Experimental results show that the accuracy of our proposed model reaches 96.7%. Compared with the other best-performing deep learning models, the proposed model improves the accuracy by 3.1% and the F1 value by 2.7%.

articleTitle: Short-term prediction of photovoltaic power based on improved Wile Horse Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: According to the volatility of photovoltaic output, a multi- kernel extreme learning machine (MKELM) based on improved Wile Horse Optimizer is proposed. First, historically similar day data sets were generated using fuzzy C mean clustering (FCM). Secondly, in view of the problem that MKELM parameters are difficult to determine, the improved Wile Horse Optimizer (IWHO) is used to optimize the kernel parameters and regularization coefficient of MKELM, which enhances the generalization ability of the model. Taking the measured data as an example, the results show that the proposed prediction model can achieve satisfactory prediction accuracy under different weather conditions, compared with the traditional support vector machine, BP neural network and long and short-term neural network error index, which effectively improves the prediction accuracy of photovoltaic output.

articleTitle: Research on Facial and Mask Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the period when the COVID-19 is raging, in order to prevent and control the epidemic, it has become normal for people to wear masks. Masks mask the face, greatly reducing the number of facial features available for recognition, and the accuracy of the original face recognition algorithm decreases. This is also an important discussion at present. Yolov3 target detection trains a large number of data sets to recognize the wearing of masks but cannot recognize the identity of the detected person. Therefore, this paper proposes a study on the simultaneous recognition of face and mask, using biometrics to locate eyes with different eyes spacing according to key point information and use Euclid algorithm to calculate. Through data matching, the face wearing masks can be accurately identified.

articleTitle: Routing optimization of electric vehicles considering real-time ambient temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to the characteristics that the energy consumption and battery capacity of electric vehicle batteries change with the change of ambient temperature, the problem of electric vehicle path under real-time ambient temperature is discussed, and a vehicle path optimization model with soft time window is constructed with the goal of optimizing comprehensive costs such as electric vehicle fixed cost, driving cost, power replenishment fee and time window penalty fee. Combined with relevant literature, the hybrid genetic annealing algorithm was used to solve the example. Finally, taking the temperature change in Beijing in May as an example, the cost analysis of cities with environmental temperature range is carried out. The results show that after considering the change of battery capacity with ambient temperature, the charging time and charging cost are better than when the battery capacity is not considered.

Author Keywords: VRP MGASA Real-time ambient temperature Battery capacity

articleTitle: Multi-fault feature extraction method based on Manifold Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of signal processing and feature extraction in multi-fault mode, a multi-fault feature extraction method based on manifold learning is proposed. On the basis of maintaining the linear relationship between neighborhood sample points in low dimensional space, the nearest neighborhood sample points are found based on Euclidean distance through locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm and the optimal local geometric embedding is obtained by linear combination. In the problem of regularization, by using the method of multiple weight vectors, the optimal solution is ensured to identify when it converges to the desired embedding. Finally, the multi-fault feature extraction is visually displayed in two-dimensional and three-dimensional images respectively to verify the effectiveness of the method based on the CMAPSS data set provided by NASA.

articleTitle: ALEmu: A Framework for Application-layer Programs Emulation of Embedded Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The difference between real devices and virtual environments causes a low success rate of application-layer program emulation when the firmware is operating in full-system emulation during the dynamic analysis of the firmware of embedded devices. In this paper, we propose ALEmu, an emulation framework for application-layer programs, which can effectively improve the emulation success rate of application-layer programs in embedded device firmware through automatic preprocessing of target programs, building configuration libraries, and hooking external program calls. When we test ALEmu on a variety of real-world devices, including routers and IP cameras, we find that it performs more successfully and accurately than the current state-of-the-art full-system emulation frameworks like Firmadyne and FirmAE.

articleTitle: An EHV Transformer Fault Diagnosis Method based on Acoustic Perception and Pseudo-Labels Intensive Training-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The importance of power transformers is more prominent in the context of EHV grid interconnection, and their state health is the basis of grid operation stability. The classic ways of monitoring transformer faults all have some impact on the transformer. Consider incorporating acoustic detection without transformer outage detection and placement of intrusive sensors. Meanwhile, in order to solve the problem of insufficient labeling of test data, an EHV transformer fault diagnosis method based on acoustic perception and pseudo labels intensive training-CNN is proposed in combination with semi-supervised training. First, the convolutional neural network is trained to ensure the classification accuracy of the model using deep learning ideas. Then, the pseudo-labels idea is introduced and the intensive training mechanism is proposed to improve the classification accuracy of the model again. Finally, the transformer acoustic data are processed and integrated as a way to validate the model performance. Experiments show that the proposed model can further improve the classification performance of the model by using the pseudo-labels intensive training mechanism on the basis of ensuring the classification accuracy. The final accuracy rate can reach more than 92.4 percent.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Based on Transformer and Multi-Spatial-Temporal Encoder-Decoder
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is one of the key research directions of intelligent transportation systems, and accurate traffic flow prediction can effectively reduce traffic congestion and improve road utilization. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, many machine learning and deep learning models have been successfully applied to traffic flow prediction. Due to the many factors influencing traffic flow, the extremely complex nonlinear relationships between these factors, and the complex temporal and spatial correlations of traffic flow, traffic flow prediction is considered a challenging problem. In this paper, a new Multi-Spatial-Temporal Encoder-Decoder Model (MST-EDM) based on Transformer is proposed to capture the temporal correlation of traffic flow more accurately. Weekly time series encoder block, daily time series encoder block and adjacent time series encoder block are used to extract weekly time series correlation, daily time series correlation and adjacent time series correlation. The temporal correlation of different time slices is fused by feature. Experiments were conducted using the PEMS04 highway datasets from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System. The results show that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

articleTitle: Effects of knee joint booster on human metabolic consumption during constant speed walking - Based on simulation software
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this study, the OpenSim simulation software was used to add a simulated knee joint booster to the basic human body model by using the knee joint kinematics and dynamics parameters, and the energy metabolism consumption value of unassisted walking and knee joint booster assisted walking was obtained. To explore the influence of knee joint booster on human walking energy metabolism, the purpose is to provide reference for the design, optimization and application of knee joint booster.

articleTitle: Research on Convolution Decomposition and Hardware Acceleration based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) is an artificial intelligence algorithm with a wide application foundation. In recent years, to improve the computational speed of the computation-intensive CNN models, many researchers have accelerated hardware implementation on FPGA. However, the acceleration algorithms are mostly unfriendly to hardware or have poor flexibility, which leads to a decrease in computing power and an increase in data access. In this paper, we propose a convolution decomposition method in the time domain, which fully considers the behavior of convolution operation and the difference between data streams in hardware. Besides, we design a hardware acceleration architecture. The results show that this design can be compatible with convolution and full connection operations of various sizes and strides. Hardware tailoring and cascade expansion are proposed for different application scenarios. Experiments show that the computing performance per DSP is 0.39 GOP/s, which demonstrates that the hardware design has a better multiplier utilization than similar works.

articleTitle: Design of data retrieval system for distributed energy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Distributed energy is the key to developing smart energy. Taking the distributed energy system in an industrial park as an example, the system generates massive structured time series data, such as productivity data, energy consumption data, and equipment data, and also generates unstructured data files, such as documents, forms, audio and video data. Because of the heterogeneity of data sources, the system uses HBase database as a storage carrier. Therefore, a secondary index scheme based on ElasticSearch+HBase is proposed and a data retrieval system is built based on the positive order index adopted in HBase. The experimental results show that this data retrieval design scheme meets the retrieval requirements.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment for Directed Weighted Complex Network by Quantifying Importance of Community Nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Vulnerability assessment of directed weighted complex networks is the prerequisite for network structure optimization. In the present work, a method based on the importance of community structure nodes is proposed. First, complex network communities are detected from networks using an improved-permanence-based method. Second, importance of nodes are quantified by calculating both internal and external community connectivity. Then, the nodes are sorted in order of importance and destroyed one by one. Based on the destroyed networks, indexes of network efficiency and connectivity are calculated, by which vulnerability of complex networks is assessed. The experimental results show that: 1) the proposed method can evaluate the vulnerability of directed weighted complex networks with multiple scales. 2) the proposed method shows good efficiency in network destruction. 3) in terms of the ability to completely destroy the network, the proportion of nodes to be destroyed is only 0.8261, 0.3200 and 0.8200 for test set, representing better performance of our method in accurately finding vulnerable nodes or regions.

articleTitle: Combined Location Method Based on Error State Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the data fusion method of iterative Error State Kalman Filter framework, this paper realizes the combined location of optical and inertial navigation. The method uses a tight coupling combination, uses the measurement value of Optical Position Sensor (OPS) to the marked point to correct the prior estimation of IMU, and takes the data error of OPS and IMU as the observation and state variables, thus simplifying the calculation of Jacobian matrix and avoiding the complexity caused by nonlinearity. The experiment shows that this method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy, enhance the robustness of OPS, and has good practicability.

articleTitle: Multi-activation stochastic configuration network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Stochastic configuration network (SCN) utilize a unique supervisory mechanism to construct hidden layer nodes to ensure the universal approximation capability, constituting a neural network with advantages such as fast convergence and guaranteed generalization error. However, the disadvantage of the original SCN is that the single activation function used could cause premature overfitting of the model as the number of hidden layer nodes continues to increase, in order to ensure the model perform better. To address the issue, a kind of improvement strategy aiming to the constructure of the hidden layer of original SCN, a multi-activation stochastic configuration network (MA-SCN) architecture is proposed in this paper. That means, the selection of the activation functions deeply dependent on data, namely, the increase progressively progress of hidden node by selecting the activation function with the best performance, so the better generalization capability of the model could obtain with compacter structure of the hidden layer. Simulation results demonstrate that the strategy of multiple activation function selection by merit can improve the accuracy of the SCN model in solving regression problems while reducing computational effort. The proposed model has been used in real industrial data cases and has fully demonstrated its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Application of “line to representative hole” drainage hole simulation method in the secondary development of abaqus
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on an explicit drainage hole simulation method - “line to representative hole” method, this paper develops twice on the finite element software abaqus.This paper uses python script to control the modeling process of drainage hole according to the characteristics of drainage hole curtain arrangement. The GUI interface is designed through the rsg dialog to facilitate the call of model scripts, material properties, and waterhead settings in seepage calculations. This effectively solves the cumbersome GUI operation in seepage calculation engineering and greatly improves the efficiency of pre-processing. This method effectively solves the cumbersome GUI operation in seepage calculation engineering and greatly improves the efficiency of pre-processing.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Multiple Traffic Time-Triggered Ethernet based on OMNeT++
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Avionics full-duplex switched Ethernet (AFDX), as the backbone network in civil avionics systems, can transmit event-based device messages. However, with the increase in real-time business requirements of avionics systems, numerous key data need to use clock synchronization at the sender to comprehensively schedule flows of different trigger mechanisms, and expand the high-bandwidth communication architecture to meet Quality of Service (QoS). This paper use OMNeT++ simulator to establish the End System (ES) and switch network topology which adopts clock synchronization on the basis of Time-Triggered Ethernet (TTE). We first simulate the End-to-End Delay of Rate Constrained traffic for each Virtual Link (VL) and compare simultaneously other two approaches to limit the End-to-End latency of AFDX, the results show that the Network Calculus (NC) and Trajectory Approaches (TA) increase in pessimism in most cases. Then we expand the Gigabit network topology of each message scheduling communication paradigm, compared with the traditional AFDX scheduling strategy, and verify that table scheduling can solve Sequence Number (SN) inversion to a certain extent. The experimental results also show that the table scheduling strategy based on time reservation can not only provide time triggered traffic planning establishes transfers to ensure low latency and minimal jitter, while also reducing worst-case end-to-end latency for Rate-Constrained (RC) and Best-Effort (BE) flows.

articleTitle: Efficient Computation Offloading for Mobile Edge Computing by Using Success-History based Adaptive DE
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: As an emerging technique, mobile edge computing (MEC) extends the resource-constrained mobile devices to offload the computation tasks to the edge servers. In this paper, both the edge MEC servers and the center Cloud servers are optional for the computation tasks offloading. Then the computation task offload problem is optimized by the improved success-history based adaptive differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed scheme can effectively reduce the time consumption and the energy consumption of the computation tasks.

articleTitle: Research on detection techniques for scanning attacks in software-defined network environments
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Cybersecurity incidents continue to plague digital life. Attackers planning to compromise a network or system often use methods such as scanning attacks to obtain valid attack information in advance, thus increasing the probability of a successful network attack. In response to this problem, the high flexibility of new architectures for software-defined networks and the OpenFlow protocoOpenFlowrovided some statistical information about network traffic in recent years. This method allows traffic to be monitored through switches that support the OpenFlow protocol and enables faster port scan detection than traditional methods of collecting periodic statistics, which can be used to detect malicious traffic activity. In this paper, we delve into the statistical rules of traffic in Openflow networks, develop and implement a traffic detection method based on port scanning in Openflow networks, establish an information entropy-based inspection mechanism, and use a mixture of two conventional traffic models and anomalous traffic for access. The experimental results show that the method can effectively and reasonably detect slow scanning attacks as well as improve the accuracy of identifying abnormal traffic.

articleTitle: Video recommendation method based on multi-attention mechanism and heterogeneous information network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The online learning platform has rich video resources. To recommend video resources suitable for learners' knowledge background and learning interests, it is necessary to know the details of each entity object related to learners. To this end, a video recommendation method based on multi-attention mechanism and heterogeneous information network is proposed. The heterogeneous information network learning method is used to obtain the representation of node feature vectors, metapath and attribute embedding; Implicit feedback matrix is used to obtain the embedding of nodes and neighbors; Use convolutional neural network to embed neighbor nodes and aggregate meta-path pairs; Multi-attention mechanism is used to modify node embedding and meta-path embedding; The above embedding is spliced and input into the fully connected neural network for learning and recommendation. The experiment was carried out on the MOOCCube and MOOCdata dataset, and the evaluation model was carried out using indicators such as accuracy, recall rate, average reciprocal ranking, and area under the working characteristic curve of subjects. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better recommendation performance than common recommendation methods.

articleTitle: SAMF-TLD Based Pedestrian Multi-Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the tracking loss problem caused by target scale change and occlusion in pedestrian multi-target tracking, a scale adaptive kernel correlation filter with tracking-learning-detection (SAMF-TLD) based multi-target tracking method is proposed. This method combines a short-time tracker with the traditional track-detect-learn (TLD) multi-target tracking algorithm, which improves the real-time performance of the algorithm and overcomes the tracking failure problem of the TLD algorithm under illumination change and large scale change. Secondly, by judging the confidence of the tracking results of the scale adaptive kernel correlation filter (SAMF), the problem of updating the filter template when the target is occluded is solved, therefore, in order to improve the tracking efficiency, effectively avoid the tracking failure problems caused by the target being occluded and the tracking target scale change. In the experiment, 2DMOT-15 and MOT-16 data sets were selected for tracking verification, and the common evaluation indicators (MOTA, MOTP, MP, MT, and IDS) were compared and analyzed. The results show that the proposed method is superior to the TLD pedestrian multi-target tracking algorithm in the accuracy, and the SAMF tracking algorithm in terms of anti-occlusion.

articleTitle: A study on the prediction model of dam seepage volume based on isolated forest-multiple stepwise linear regression
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the study of hydraulic seepage prediction, it is often necessary to target multiple feature dimensions. In this paper, a variety of traditional machine learning algorithms based on stepwise regression filtering features are used to train a dam seepage prediction model based on isolated forest processing of data outliers. The results show that the algorithm can be applied to predict the seepage data of a reservoir more accurately, and further suggest improvements to the dam's seepage control function and observation facilities. The experimental results show that the correlation coefficient of the linear regression model is significantly improved when the training sample ratio is 0.8 after the isolated forest treatment of outliers and stepwise regression screening features.

articleTitle: An algorithmic and practical study of an improved least squares influence coefficient method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large residual vibration and large balancing mass at some measurement points in the process of rotor dynamic balancing by the least squares influence coefficient method, a hybrid PSO-SSA optimization algorithm is proposed and introduced into the rotor dynamic balancing by the least squares influence coefficient method. The simulation results show that the PSO-SSA algorithm has good global convergence characteristics and stability. Finally, compared with the basic algorithm, the improved algorithm can effectively limit the counterweight mass and reduce the residual vibration, which verifies the correctness of the optimization algorithm and the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Grey Principal Component Analysis in Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Predictive analysis is one of the most important application fields of big data analytics, which can predict uncertain events by combining various advanced analysis functions, especially statistical analysis and other methods. Big data analytics technology is mainly applied in business intelligence, government decision-making, public services and so on. In response to the shortcomings of principal component analysis method in processing data with time series, a new model, namely grey principal component analysis (GPCA), is proposed by combining grey system thinking with classical principal component analysis based on the characteristics of data with time series in grey systems. Time series analysis can not only quantitatively reveal the development and changes of a certain phenomenon, but also dynamically depict the internal quantitative relationships and changes between a certain phenomenon and other phenomena. Through the generation and development of series, the grey system theory devotes itself to the discussion of practical laws, while mathematical statistics devotes itself to the study of statistical historical laws. Combining the advantages of the two methods to solve time series problems, the system was implemented using object-oriented programming methods. The application of this method to the comprehensive evaluation of living environment indicators in Dalian highlights the impact of new time series data on the entire data, and the analysis results can provide valuable decision-making basis for decision-makers. The experimental results indicate that the use of grey principal component analysis is more effective and can accurately reflect the impact of time on the sample data.

articleTitle: Optimal design of pure electric SUV based on Multi Island Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Nowadays, SUV is developing rapidly.
