This paper matches the drive motor, power battery and transmission system of a pure electric SUV according to the power and economic requirements of a traditional SUV. The vehicle is modeled by AVL Cruise software, and the power and economy of the vehicle are simulated to meet the requirements of power and economy. In order to further improve economy, a joint simulation model of Cruise and Isight is built and Multi Island Genetic Algorithm(MIGA) is chosen. The final ratio and the rolling radius of the tire are optimization parameters. The vehicle economy is calculated as the optimization target. The optimization results show that power consumption per 100 kilometers is reduced by 0.38kWh and the economy is increased by 2.60% under the optimized New European Driving Cycle(NEDC) cycle condition.

articleTitle: Capacity price – energy price coordination mechanism suitable for new power system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the gradual progress of the construction of a new power system, a high proportion of new energy connections, large-scale energy storage facilities, cross-regional transmission and distribution projects continue to be built, and more and more capacity related investment in the power grid. However, the current capacity electricity price formation mechanism in China cannot realize the effective recovery and fair allocation of capacity cost, and the cost recovery effect is poor. Aiming at the problem that capacity cost is difficult to recover effectively, this paper puts forward a method to readjust the ratio of capacity cost in capacity price and energy price based on BARY curve. Aiming at the problem of equitable allocation of capacity cost on the user side, this paper proposes a user classification method based on user load rate clustering to realize differentiated capacity cost allocation for users with different load rates.

articleTitle: Research on named entity recognition method for rich text elements of test questions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The lack of some rich text information such as graphs, tables and expressions for solving the questions in important examinations directly affects the specification of the examination paper. Therefore, this paper uses the method of named entity recognition to get the text description of pictures, tables and expressions from the test text, and gives a warning when the examination paper is examined. The baseline model was the BiLSTM-CRF model, aiming at the problem of rare entities and unclear boundary information in the self-built test question data set, an unsupervised BERT pre-training model was incorporated at the character level to obtain the dynamic character vector representation. Three dictionaries are introduced into the word set, and the multi-head attention mechanism is utilized to modify the weight of words in various word sets. As the input of the basic model, characters and words are finally combined to create more semantic information. According to the experimental data, the model's F<inf>1</inf> value on the created test data set may reach 89.6%, which is 1.4% and 0.6% higher than those of BERT-BiLSTM-CRF and Softlexicon, respectively.

articleTitle: The Application of Target Embedding AutoEncoder based on Knowledge Distillation in Multi-View Multi-Label Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In multi-view learning, how to effectively integrate features among multiple views becomes a key challenge. For multi-label tasks, it is extremely important that the relationship between features and labels. This paper proposes a Target Embedding Autoencoder framework based on knowledge distillation (tea-mvml), which explores the correlation between features and labels in Multi-View Multi-Label (MVML) learning. The framework transfers knowledge from a teacher model based on a Target Embedding Autoencoder (TEA) to a small student model through knowledge distillation. The teacher model of tea-mvml learns the relationship between features and labels in the potential space, while the student model has the generalization ability of the teacher model. Experimental results on multiple real-world datasets show that tea-mvml not only reduces the complexity of the model, but also outperforms other state-of-the-art multi-view multi-label classification approaches.

articleTitle: Research on Force Fighting Verification Technology of Dual-redundancy Electro-hydraulic Actuator System Based on RSS Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the force fighting problem between redundant actuators in the primary flight control system of a certain type of civil aircraft, the verification technology of force equalization control algorithm is proposed in this paper. The force balance feedback controller is designed and implemented.A new method based on RSS (Root-Sum-Squares) is proposed to estimate the worst case of force fighting, The simulation and evaluation of the control effect after adding the equalization algorithm are carried out under the condition of single influence parameter and all influence parameters acting together. The simulation results show that the force balance algorithm in the primary flight control surface actuation system well meet the control requirements. Finally, the effect of force balance control is verified by the iron bird tests, and the results show that the simulation results and the performance requirements of the system are satisfied.

articleTitle: Tibetan Aspect Extraction based on syllable feature
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The paper proposes a new approach to evaluation target extraction for Tibetan news texts, which integrates Tibetan syllable components and character features to address segmentation errors propagation issues caused by previous models utilizing word embedding. The model used Bi-LSTM for feature extraction after feature fusion in the encoder and CRF(Conditional Random Field) for target output. The experimental results showed that the proposed model performed better than previous models

articleTitle: Research on automatic test paper generating method based on improved differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To further improve the speed and efficiency, this paper proposed the improved differential evolution algorithm combined with the adaptive technology and simplex search algorithm. The mathematical model was designed to represent an intelligent test paper-generating process in quantitative form. Combined with the mathematical model, the improved differential evolution algorithm was applied to automatically extract the optimal paper that meets the user's needs of multiple goals. The efficiency of the differential evolution algorithm was improved by improving the initial population, the evolutionary strategy, the worst individuals using the simplex search algorithm, and the adaptive calculation of the scale factor F and the cross-probability factor CR. Experiments show that the improved algorithm is faster and better than the improved algorithm and can meet the needs of online examination systems from the question bank.

articleTitle: View self-attention network for 3D object recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: View-based 3D object recognition maps a 3D object from different angles to a set of images to represent the 3D object. In traditional view-based methods, simple pooling operations aggregate information from multiple views without taking into account the connections between the views. This results in the loss of many important information and creates redundancy of information. In this paper, we propose a view self-attention network. Specifically, the network consists of two parts, the first part is a single-view self-attention network and the second part is a multi-view self-attention network. Single-view self-attention network explores the relationship between local features of a single view. Multi-view self-attention network explores the connections between views and and find the important views to reduce information redundancy. The validation of our model on benchmark datasets modelnet40, modelnet10 illustrates the effectiveness and superiority of our model.

articleTitle: Vertical Text Recognition System Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper designs a vertical text recognition system based on the attention mechanism, which can recognize not only horizontal text but also vertical text. The system is divided into two parts: recognition and web. The recognition part includes the generation of data sets, image preprocessing and text recognition. The text recognition is divided into two processes: encoding and decoding. The web part mainly displays visually to facilitate the user experience. Because the vertical text data set is scarce, the generated data set is used here to train the neural network. The size of the training set is 750,000 images, and the test set has 75,000 images. The recognition accuracy of the test on the generated test set has reached 98%.

articleTitle: Topological robustness of supply chain networks under disruptions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Supply chain networks (SCNs) are facing numerous disruptions caused by growing uncertainties. To cope with these uncertainties, it is crucial to design a robust structure for the supply chain network. In this study, we employ a simulation approach to address the topological robustness of SCNs under disruptions. We develop the Barabasi and Albert (BA) model for the formation of SCNs by considering preferential attachment and rewiring edges simultaneously. Then, we use the disruption model to simulate supply chain disruptions in real-world SCNs, which includes six node-removed strategies. Moreover, topological indicators, the relative size of the largest connected component and network efficiency, are applied to represent the robustness of SCNs. The results of the simulation experiments show that the generation process determines the topological structures of SCNs. Also, the HCIA strategy is the most destructive while the Random strategy is the least destructive. In addition, the performance of SCNs changes with different topological structures and different disruptions. In some situations, the network efficiency of SCNs with some topological structures keeps nearly unchanged to Random disruptions. These conclusions have important implications for research and practice in supply chain management.

articleTitle: Infrared and visible image fusion based on dense connectivity and Transformer self-encoding
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Most of the existing deep learning-based infrared and visible image fusion methods use convolutional neural networks for feature extraction, but the perceptual field of convolutional neural networks becomes smaller as the depth of the convolutional layers increases, and it is difficult to focus on the global features of the source image. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a self-encodering based on the combination of dense connection module and Transformer module, and the Transformer module can extract the non-local interaction relationship of the source image from the entire image, focus more on the global features, and the dense connection module better understands the local features of the original image. In addition, the existing loss function lacks the deep semantic information of the image, and this paper introduces perceptual loss in the loss function to better retain the texture and detail information in the image of the image. After the source image is featured extracted by the self-encoder designed herein, the fused image is obtained by the reconstruction of the decoder. Experimental results show that compared with nine traditional and deep learning-based image fusion methods, the methods in this article have better performance in subjective comparison and objective image quality evaluation.

articleTitle: DRL-based Multi-Hop Relational Reasoning for Personnel Management Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the personnel management knowledge graph, the absence of relations will lead to an incomplete knowledge graph, which affects downstream applications. While existing approaches can handle relational reasoning tasks, many neglect reasoning efficiency and implicit semantic information in multi-hop relational paths. Therefore, we proposed a multi-hop relational reasoning model based on deep reinforcement learning to reason out paths with implicit semantic information. We optimize the proximal policy optimization algorithm to implement reasoning. The irrelevant actions masking scheme makes the reasoning more efficient. And the reward shaping make the reasoned multi-hop relational paths semantically interpretable. We construct a formal dataset containing a large number of triples to represent the personnel management knowledge graph. By comparing the experimental results on metrics about MAP, MRR, Hits@k, and frequency of paths with other baselines, our proposed model is more advantageous in the personnel management knowledge graph. In addition, experimental results on the dataset NELL-995 show that our proposed model's performance can compare to the mainstream methods.

articleTitle: Improved Spherical Evolution Algorithm with Intelligent Tuning of Search Space
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The spherical evolution (SE) search algorithm has a more novel search style than the common meta-heuristic algorithm. In contrast to the traditional hypercube search model, SE uses a spherical search approach and achieves very good results. Although the SE algorithm is very effective, it suffers from the problem of sometimes slow convergence due to the large search space and the imbalance between the development of the algorithm and the exploration capability. To address this, we innovatively proposed a strategy to intelligently adjust the search space based on the population structure information and improved the SE algorithm (ISE). Review of the effectiveness of our strategy, we compare ISE with SE algorithm and several other well-known meta-heuristic algorithms. Our problems with 30 different solution spaces on the IEEE CEC2017 benchmark serve as the test set for the experiments. The experimental results show that ISE has a significant advantage over other algorithms.

articleTitle: Air Quality Prediction Based on Improved LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The quality of air has a serious impact on social and economic development and the health of the population. In order to keep track of the trend of air quality, it is especially important to forecast it accurately. In this paper, we study the application of LSTM in air quality prediction. Firstly, in order to solve the problem that LSTM only focuses on the previous information, this paper uses BiLSTM to read the before and after data simultaneously and extract the features from them when predicting air quality. Then, to address the problem that BiLSTM tends to lose information when dealing with long air quality data, this paper uses an attention mechanism to selectively use the input information by weighting the results of the hidden layer of BiLSTM. Finally, the model proposed in this paper is validated. The experimental results show that the improved LSTM model is more accurate in predicting air quality.

articleTitle: One-Dimensional Statistical Parametric Mapping Identifies Plantar Regional Loading Differences Related to Medial Longitudinal Arch Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Statistical parameter mapping (SPM) as a statistical test based on spatio-temporal smoothing and data normalization has been widely employed in computer engineering and biomechanical research. The present study aimed to analyze the influences of different medial longitudinal arch stiffness on the differences in gait plantar loadings by computer-based one-dimensional SPM. Fifty-four asymptomatic male subjects were recruited for the study based on the results of the G*Power analysis. A foot scanner was employed to acquire three-dimensional foot morphology under different load conditions for the calculation of arch stiffness. The dynamic plantar pressure data were collected from the ten plantar anatomical regions during the gait task. The results indicated that individuals with more flexible medial longitudinal arches experienced significantly increased plantar loading in the toe, medial metatarsal, and hindfoot regions during gait while significantly lower in the midfoot region. Combined with the SPM & SnPM statistics, this recorded dataset of time-series plantar region loading variability caused by differences in arch stiffness is essential for the interpretation of foot biomechanical function and injury prediction associated with arch morphology.

articleTitle: An asynchronous architecture based on matrix operation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Matrix operations are widely available in various engineering and scientific computing applications; however, the calculation efficiency depends on the input data density. These operations cannot complete the calculation using only one inner/outer product method. Meanwhile, most of the current computational accelerator architectures use synchronous clock circuits. As the technology approaches its limit and the scale of the circuit increases, the disadvantage of clock circuits becomes more and more obvious. Clock circuits fail to meet the very low power requirements of specific fields. To address this problem, this paper proposes an asynchronous computing architecture that supports matrix computing micro-instructions. It selects the appropriate calculation method by sensing the data density. For SPGEMM, a two-way condensation technique is adopted to solve the problem of data volume. A “one-to-one” merge strategy to reduce the uncertainty of the merge process is further proposed. For SRAM, an asynchronous management mechanism is developed to ensure the uniformity of the overall architecture. Finally, the area of this architecture is 17.3 mm<sup>2</sup>, and the power demand is only 0.00468 W in the 110-nm process. This research evaluates the device on the SuiteSparse set and random matrix set, it also achieves 62.3×, and 11.25× energy savings over OuterSPACE and SpArch, respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Power Performance of the Four-Wheel Drive Pickup Truck Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A pickup truck is an important automobile with dual characteristics of domestic automobile and commercial automobile. Its power performance will directly affect the driving performance of the whole automobile. According to the basic parameters and driving performance requirements of the four-wheel drive pickup truck, a mathematical model of automobile power is established by MATLAB. Through a series of calculations and simulations, the power performance index of the automobile is obtained. The power performance of automobile is analyzed according to the simulation results. The simulation results show that the power performance index of the automobile meets the design requirements, which is of great significance to the further development of the whole automobile.

articleTitle: A Threshold Assembler-Based Algorithm for Accurate Systolic Peak Detection in Photoplethysmography Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This study presents a novel algorithm for accurately detecting the systolic peak in photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. The proposed algorithm utilizes a threshold assembler approach <tex>$\mathbf{that}$</tex> combines four simple thresholding conditions, namely normalized threshold, differential threshold, amplitude threshold, and interval threshold, through a logical judgment process. The effectiveness of the algorithm is demonstrated through a comparison with other existing research in both low-error and high-complexity environments, and the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves the best precision in detecting the systolic peak of PPG signals compared to other existing algorithms. The findings of this study confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for detecting the systolic peak of PPG signals. Moreover, future studies could optimize the algorithm by using larger and better-distributed datasets. Overall, these results demonstrate the potential impact of the threshold assembler-based algorithm for improving the accuracy of systolic peak detection in PPG signals, and its potential to contribute to the development of PPG-based healthcare applications.

articleTitle: An Attribute-enhanced Method based on Latent Space Factorization for Face Image Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, arbitrary style transfer (AST) with high quality develops rapidly and the application is widespread. Customers desire to stylize their portraits and edit face attributes simultaneously. To satisfy people's demands, we design a whole framework to complete both global style transfer in color and local style transfer in attributes. First, a target attribute enhancement module guided by the latent space factorization is presented to alleviate over-editing problems and obtain style codes. Then, a local-global fusion module is proposed to integrate target style codes and global features. Besides, a contrastive coherence preserving loss is built in a pre-trained style transfer network to better adapt to face images. The experiments show that our model can generate pleasant images.

articleTitle: Lightweight Dilated Residual Convolution AMP Network for Image Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Recently, image compressed sensing (ICS) has achieved brilliant reconstruction accuracy. However, it comes at a price of an explosion in resource occupation. In this work, with the aim of a low-consumption ICS method without sacrificing any accuracy, we propose a lightweight deep unfolding network to conquer this shortcoming. The proposed Dilated Residual Convolution AMP-Net (DRCAMP-Net) utilizes dilated residual convolution to enlarge the convolution receptive filed during block-by-block recovery and blocking artifacts eliminating, which results in considerable performance with much fewer calculate complexity. Furthermore, by discussing the impact of block size, we choose the optimal block size to greatly optimize the model size and reconstruction speed while maintaining the accuracy. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method achieves considerable reconstruction accuracy or even better than existing state-of-the-art methods with only <tex>$6.65\times$</tex> speed and roughly 1/6 model size.

articleTitle: Design and research of vacuum thermal environment test network in spacecraft development process
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the vacuum thermal environment test of spacecraft, IP program-controlled power supply and IP-based control equipment are deployed and applied on a large scale. The vacuum thermal environment test network system provides various IP test equipment access interfaces, and provides data transmission links for the vacuum thermal measurement and control system. This system has many advantages such as strong scalability, high stability, and wide coverage. In the design and research of the vacuum thermal environment test network system, LACP is used to expand the link bandwidth; Stacking technology realizes equipment redundancy; VPN technology realizes remote communication of measurement and control system, completes interconnection of all measurement and control subsystems of vacuum thermal environment test, realizes remote centralized measurement and control, centralized storage of test data and data sharing, and improves the informatization level of spacecraft development process.

articleTitle: Research and Proof of Ecological Nature of Online Public Opinion Dissemination
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Existing studies on the propagation model of online public opinion based on the propagation mechanism of infectious diseases are mainly based on the similarities between the two, and few researchers have studied and analyzed the similarities between them; meanwhile, considering the proportion of positive types of information in public opinion topics will have an impact on the trend of the change of public opinion status surface. To this end, an ecological model of online public opinion with dynamic propagation rate is proposed, the completeness of the model is verified by using the existing completeness theorem, and empirical analysis is conducted using real online topics, and the results show that the model can better simulate the changing trends of the proportion of real information in different states, which verifies the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Localization and Segmentation of Galaxy Morphology Based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Segmentation and accurate positioning of galaxies is one of the important steps in the study of survey galaxy images. However, thanks to the development of large astronomical observation equipment, astronomy has entered the era of big data, so it is difficult to use traditional methods to solve this demand. As an effective method of massive data analysis, deep learning has great potential in astronomical image processing. Therefore, this paper proposes a method based on Mask R-CNN to locate and segment galaxy morphology. The dataset from the Galaxy Park Project is first preprocessed to address the problems of overfitting and underfitting. Then transfer learning and decay learning rate strategies are used to train the model. Finally, the experimental results show that the trained model can be used to locate and segment four types of commonly used galaxy images. The mAP@0.5 can achieve an accuracy of 93%, so we can determine the type, location and boundary information of galaxies with relatively high accuracy.

articleTitle: Spatial-Spectral Dual-Branch Autoencoder based on Adaptive Convolution for Hyperspectral Unmixing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing interest in the use of deep learning-based hyperspectral unmixing methods. However, most existing networks only extract either spectral information or local spatial-spectral correlations of a single pixel, and their performance is often unsatisfactory. To address this issue and further extract spatial-spectral information from hyperspectral images, In this paper, a novel hyperspectral unmixing method based on spatial-spectral dual branch autoencoder and adaptive convolution is proposed. This method utilizes the autoencoder architecture with different branches designed to extract both spatial and spectral features. The extracted features are then stacked and propagated through the network, followed by mapping to obtain the abundance percentage. Additionally, We have incorporated sparsity constraint on the loss function as a way to exploit the correlation between neighboring pixels and further improve the unmixing performance. We evaluated the performance of our proposed method on two real hyperspectral datasets, and the results demonstrate significant accuracy compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Deep search based prototype estimation method for few-shot image classification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Few-shot learning aims to transfer training models for base classes with sufficient labeled data to adapt to novel classes with only a few training examples. In this paper, we propose a deep search based prototype estimation method to improve few-shot learning. Based on the deep search, the similarity between the data in the base class can be used to better complete the prototype of the support set category. After obtaining similar samples, we can generate a prototype and then use it to estimate the distribution of the category to improve the few-shot learning task. A comparative experiment is carried out on three benchmark datasets to evaluate the effectiveness of our algorithm for few-shot learning. The results show that our method can generate more robust samples and significantly improve the few-shot learning, which is superior to the most advanced methods on these datasets.

articleTitle: Sound signal-based transformer operation status monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a system for monitoring the operational status of transformers based on sound signals. The system employs an adaptive noise reduction technique to preprocess the sound signals and a random forest algorithm to classify the signals into different operational states. The adaptive noise reduction technique effectively removes background noise and other irrelevant sound signals, allowing for more accurate monitoring of the transformers. The random forest algorithm is a popular machine learning technique that can handle complex, high-dimensional datasets, making it well-suited for analyzing the large number of features extracted from sound signals. Experimental results from field tests on four transformers demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is effective in identifying the operational states of the transformers and can provide timely alerts when faults occur. The system presented in this paper can serve as a useful tool for monitoring the health of transformers.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Enhancement Based on Superpixel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: An infrared image enhancement method based on superpixel segmentation is proposed to address the quality degradation problems such as low signal-to-noise ratio, poor contrast and blurred edge details commonly found in infrared images. Firstly, the infrared image is segmented into sub-maps of similar size and structure by a superpixel segmentation method based on Gaussian mixture model; then the superpixel segmented sub-maps are further classified into significant sub-map and non-significant sub-map by combining the saliency feature maps, and then the two sub-maps are subjected to dual-platform histogram equalization respectively to achieve the purpose of image enhancement. The results of the simulation of infrared images using this algorithm show that, compared to the global histogram equalization, the peak signal-to-noise ratio and the structural similarity are improved by about 15.5% and 11.1% respectively. At the same time, the algorithm not only improves the overall visual effect of the infrared image from the perspective of the visual characteristics of the human eyes, but also effectively suppresses the overexposure and under-enhancement phenomena.

articleTitle: Grid risk intelligent analysis system based on communication network and power grid coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as lack of coupling analysis means between power communication network and power grid and lack of simulation auxiliary system, an intelligent analysis system of power network risk based on the coupling of communication network and power grid is designed and implemented. The system includes three modules, such as multi-source data coupling module, intelligent diagnosis module and maintenance auxiliary module. The coupling model of communication network and power grid is established, which includes five steps: initial setup, initial fault, sub-graph detection, communication service rerouting, dynamic PTN load updating and overload detection. Based on the communication network data, protection data, N-l analysis data and N-2 analysis data, the source side confidence algorithm based on time-sharing weight and multi-source power network fault diagnosis algorithm are designed. The deployment and application of the system improves the multi-source data fusion rate and fault detection accuracy in Panxi region.

articleTitle: ECG abnormality detection Based on Multi-domain combination features and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Most scholars use fixed-length sample to ECG abnormalities based on MIT-BIH dataset, which lead to information loss. To address this problem, this paper proposes a method for ECG abnormality detection based on TSH-L method. The TSH-L method include:(1) Use the 3R ECG sample selection method to select ECG samples.(2) Extract multi-domain combination features including time-domain features, frequency domain features and time-frequency domain features.(3) LSTM is used for classification, and the algorithm is trained and tested based on the MIT-BIH dataset, obtain relatively optimal features as spliced normalized fusion features including kurtosis, skewness and RR interval time domain features, STFT-based sub-band spectrum features, and harmonic ratio features. Experiments show that: TSH-L method proposed in the paper has a high accuracy of 97.74% for the detection of ECG abnormalities of MIT-BIH dataset. The method 3R-TSH-L proposed in this paper is expected to be widely used in family-oriented healthcare.

articleTitle: Incomplete multiview subspace clustering algorithm based on self-representation and consistent learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Incomplete multiview clustering is an important topic in machine learning due to ubiquitous incompleteness of view in the real data in life. The incompleteness of views is prevalent in real life. In this paper, we propose an incomplete multiview subspace learning method based on self-representation learning and graph fusion. The proposed method construct the robust graph of each view through the self-expression and semi-nonegative matrix decomposition, and learn a consistent representation of all views by Laplace co-regularization based on the low-dimensional representation of the each view. Through the learned consistent representation, the incomplete multiview can be divided by k-means. Experiments is implemented on 3 benchmark datasets and the superior results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Secure Authentication Protocol for VANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) offer additional opportunities for the development of intelligent transportation. Network-connected vehicles can help drivers adjust their driving environment and improve overall road safety by accessing information such as maps, signal status and road conditions. Due to the open nature of the communication channel, it is necessary for the receiving vehicle to verify the source and integrity of the message. Most of the existing researches are based on PKI certificate authentication model. However, there are some problems in this model: the distribution, storage and revocation of identity certificates need to consume a lot of vehicle resources, and the centralized structural framework cannot form an effective supervision of node operation. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes an identity authentication mechanism based on blockchain and zero-knowledge proof. In the blockchain structure composed of fog nodes, vehicles only need to store the generation seeds of communication pseudonyms to complete the communication within the coverage of fog nodes, which can effectively reduce the resource overhead caused by pseudonym distribution and revocation. Security analysis shows that our scheme can meet the security requirements of VANETs, and performance analysis shows that our scheme is better than existing schemes.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment of Human with Metal Implants Exposed to Magnetic Field Based on Numerical Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper presents the dosimetric evaluation of the human exposure to electromagnetic fields from an Electric vehicles power supply system working from 10-Hz to 10 MHz. A realistic siting human model is deformed, and a metal implant model is developed to assessment the induced electrical field. We perform the quasi-static calculation for the 99th percentile induced electric field and current density. The results show that when the population implanted with metal objects is exposed to the electric vehicle induced magnetic field environment, the induced electric field value is higher than the general population but still below the existing guideline restrictions.

articleTitle: Multi-armed Bandit with Time-variant Budgets
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Based on the traditional paradigm of multi-armed bandit with a fixed total budget, we further investigate the multi-armed bandit with time-variant budgets (MAB-TV), which captures the situation where the learner's actions are constrained by a random budget in each round of arm-pulling. Besides, we assume that the learner needs to pay a random cost for pulling a particular arm and could obtain a random reward accordingly. The learner can pull multiple arms in each round, as long as the corresponding random budget is satisfied. To solve MAB-TV, we design a Greedy-TV algorithm. During each round, we first estimate the real average values of the reward and the cost of each arm, and then under the budget constraint, we pull some arms according to the estimated ratio of the average reward to the average cost regarding each arm. We derive the regret bound of Greedy-Tvregarding the achievable sum of rewards. Evaluations results validate the superiority of Greedy-TV, compared with three existing benchmark algorithms under varying distributions of rewards and costs and the different number of arms.

articleTitle: Research on Production optimization of process workshop based on Wolf pack algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the scheduling optimization problem in the process-oriented food production and processing finished goods area, this paper proposes an improved wolf pack algorithm to solve the problem and obtain smaller completion time by optimizing the order loading sequence of the finished food production area. A backward learning strategy is used to construct a higher quality initial population, and the ability to jump out of local extremes is enhanced by adding a simulated annealing algorithm, which results in better overall convergence performance and higher stability of the algorithm. The effectiveness of the solution method is proved through simulation experiments, and the operation plan that can improve the production efficiency and meet the production scheduling requirements of process-oriented production enterprises is given under the premise of ensuring the production operation of enterprises.

articleTitle: Deep neural network based interpolation of sparse samples for time-dense power load forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Large amount of power load data with high-sampling rate plays a crucial role in the training of time-dense power load forecasting network. However, in many cases, there is a large amount of data with low-sampling rate, which can't directly train a time-dense forecasting network. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning based dataset interpolation method, which uses the available high-sampling rate power load datasets to train a dataset interpolation network, then interpolates the low--sampling rate datasets with trained network to obtain high-sampling rate datasets, and finally uses the interpolated datasets for time-dense forecasting network training. The results show that the data obtained based on the method proposed in this paper fits the ground-truth closer than the traditional interpolation, and the results of the network trained based on this dataset are more accurate in the subsequent forecasting tasks.

articleTitle: A dual BIOS safe startup method based on national devices
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Because the information technology is developed rapidly, storage computing devices have been widely used in the field of information. When more and more important data is stored in storage computing devices, the reliability and security of storage computing devices for data has become an important issue. But in the use of storage computing devices, there is a probability that the storage computing devices cannot be started the system due to the abnormal operation of BIOS, which will be a potential security risk of causing data loss. Aiming at this problem, a dual-BIOS safe startup method applied to the nationwide production of devices has been designed. Specifically, the storage computing device contains two BIOS with two mirror data backups in each BIOS. When one mirror data of the primary BIOS is damaged, the device will automatically switch to another mirror data or switch to the mirror data of the secondary BIOS. Simultaneously, a warning signal will be sent to the system when the device system is started successfully. Then the failed BIOS will be automatically troubleshot and updated. The security startup method designed in this paper can not only improve the reliability of storage computing devices and data security, but also enable BIOS to have self-recovery function.

articleTitle: Recognizing small-data Chinese invoices through pretrained models
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Detection and recognition of text instances from invoice data is an important topic in optical character recognition (OCR). For conventional OCR models, large training datasets are usually required to achieve a high-quality learning performance. However, when only small training data are available, how to achieve a sufficiently low error rate is crucial for practical real-life applications. Here, we propose to combine the two neural networks, PSENet and TrOCR, to implement OCR for small invoice data in Chinese. Specifically, due to the fact that PSENet and TrOCR are pre-trained text detection and recognition models, they are expected to perform well even on small datasets. Simulation results show that our method can reach a low character error ratio (CER) of 0.0267 with a small training data of size 202.

articleTitle: Tower Crane Driver's Driving Behavior Detection Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a tower crane driver behavior system based on computer vision to address distracted and fatigued driving issues. For distracted driving detection, the filter pruning technique is used to compress the YOLOv5 network architecture, and the model is deployed on embedded devices using the TensorRT framework, achieving an average mAP of 96.6% and a detection speed of 27 fps. For fatigue driving detection, the PERCLOS and PMOT indicators are used to detect fatigue status, with a detection accuracy of 94% and a detection speed of 20 fps. The system can simultaneously detect distracted driving and fatigued driving while maintaining the same accuracy, and the overall running speed is 14–17 fps, which meets the requirements of practical applications.

articleTitle: Network Security Situation Prediction Based on CPSO-WaveNet
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A cross-particle swarm optimization approach is suggested that improves the WaveNet network security situation prediction model (CPSO-WaveNet) in order to increase the model's prediction accuracy and speed. Using WaveNet's advantageous nature of easy extraction of time series data, the features among network security situation data are learned, and accurate prediction is performed. Meanwhile, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is improved by introducing a vertical crossover operation to enhance population diversity. The model's hyperparameters are optimized using crossover particle swarm optimization (CPSO). In the experiments, on the one hand, the effectiveness of the crossover particle swarm algorithm is verified by two standard test functions. On the other hand, the simulation experiments and the established prediction model are compared with the traditional prediction method, and the proposed prediction method can achieve a fit of 0.9908. Comparing the convergence speed to the comparison algorithm, it is noticeably faster.

articleTitle: Material Stiffness Prediction Based on Neural Network and Symbolic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The effective stiffness of multi-inclusion composite materials is difficult to derive using theoretical methods since the localization relationships are usually complicated. In the past decades, researchers used numerical methods represented by the finite element method (FEM) to calculate the effective stiffness of multi-inclusion composites. However, FEM is time costly and cannot achieve real-time stiffness prediction. The emergence of machine learning methods provides a solution for realizing accurate real-time prediction, but making the machine learning model explainable in physical problems remains a crucial challenge. In this work, a machine learning method based on the convolutional neural network (CNN) and symbolic regression algorithm is used to achieve real-time stiffness prediction and give explicable expressions. The CNN model can predict the effective stiffness coefficients of multi-inclusion composites with all the mean absolute errors less than 2%. Using the data generated by the CNN model, the symbolic regression model based on the genetic algorithm can derive the expression of stiffness coefficients and provides a fast and explainable solution for stiffness prediction of multi-inclusion composites.

articleTitle: Fast Hash Image Retrieval by Hierarchical Polarized Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Nowadays, the amount of data in image retrieval databases is increasing, which faces great challenges in retrieval time and storage cost. Therefore, image retrieval methods based on hash have attracted extensive attention. These methods can map high-dimensional features of images into low-dimensional hash codes to reduce retrieval time and storage costs. In this paper, a hierarchical polarized network HPN is proposed to learn hierarchical and accurate hash codes. The network generate accurate superclass features and particular subclass features for each image. Hierarchical retrieval is used to speed up the retrieval time and enhance retrieval accuracy. And we use a differentiable multilevel polarization loss function to optimize the network. Polarization loss can push each channel in the network outputs away from zero, and we do not need to use pairs or triples of labels, which makes the process of learning hash codes simple and efficient. The strategies of step-by-step update, adaptive update and ternary assignment are used to further improve the discrimination of hash codes. Extensive experiments on CIFAR100, miniImageNet and DeepFashion three public datasets show that our proposed hierarchical polarized network HPN outperforms the existing image retrieval methods based on hash and hierarchy in accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Work Order Acceptance System Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Professional customer service to solve or circulate corresponding customer problems can not only solve customer problems quickly, improve the service image of the enterprise, but also lay a solid foundation for the future business development of the enterprise. By analyzing the demand of the work order system of the sports lottery customer service call center, a work order processing system based on a microservice architecture is constructed in the article. This article mainly explains and implements the five modules ofincoming call management, outgoing call management, permission management, questionnaire management, and customer management. The system is implemented using software development methods such as the Spring Cloud distributed system framework and Redis. The service deployment methods of cluster services and master-slave serviceswere adopted. The Docker platform technology was used to configure the system's operating environment, and the JMeter stress test tool was used to test the system's high-availability aspects during the test. Strongly expandable work order system. At the same time, the system uses the Word2vec module in Python to construct a short text keyword extraction method, exposes the service API, and registers it with the service registration center for use by the work order acceptance system, improving the agent's tagging of work orders's efficiency.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 for Stroller and Luggage Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With economic development and social progress, urban infrastructure is constantly improving. In public places such as shopping malls and subways, escalators are very common and provide great convenience for citizens. However, some irregular behaviours on the escalator have brought great safety hazards. Carrying large luggage and strollers onto the escalator is a typical risky behaviour. How to detect large luggage and strollers in time and issue an alarm is an important part of abnormal detection of escalators. This paper introduces the CBAM module based on YOLOv5, and conducts experiments on the collected data sets. Experimental results show that our proposed model improves the object detection performance well.

articleTitle: DC-FMDT: A Fuzzy Model Decision Tree Algorithm Based on Drug Combination Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of the field of medicine, more and more diseases have been cured. To analyze the relationship between drugs and diseases faster, people began to use machine learning technology as a means to assist doctors in treating diseases. There are hundreds of known methods for medicine, and a large proportion of these techniques use deep neural networks, which are difficult to interpret model structures. This shortcoming is magnified in areas such as medicine, which require ethics because the price of misjudgment is enormous. If the doctor does not know the decision-making logic of the model clearly, it will cause great insecurity. To this end, we propose a fuzzy model tree algorithm DC-FMDT, which combines the characteristics of the pairwise appearance of drugs in the combination drug dataset, which not only preserves the interpretability of the decision tree model but also has good performance. Finally, our algorithm is validated in the drug combination dataset of the two cell lines.

articleTitle: Joint Task Offloading, Resource Allocation and Data Caching in MEC-assisted Vehicular Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the Internet of Vehicles, a variety of vehicle applications provide convenience for people to drive and travel. Among the tasks generated by these applications, some are computing-intensive and delay-sensitive, and need data caching to complete the task. Against this background, our paper considers a MEC-assisted vehicular network where vehicles need to complete the tasks during driving. Through jointly optimizing the offloading decision, MEC server computing resource allocation and data caching decision, we propose an optimization problem to minimize the total cost of vehicles, which can improve the quality of service (QOS). Because the optimization problem is a Mixed-Integer Non-Linear Programming (MINLP) problem, we divide it into two subproblems. We propose an algorithm JOMAD to solve the MINLP problem, mainly using discrete Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO) to solve two subproblems respectively. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves less cost than other benchmarks.

articleTitle: Keyword mask pre-training model for the review of standard declaration
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The review of standard declaration of import and export commodities refers to the evaluation of whether the declaration information of the commodities filled in by enterprises conforms to the customs filling standards according to the standardized declaration catalogue The manual review method cannot meet the actual work needs. Therefore, using text classification algorithm to conduct this task is necessary. The classification method based on the pre-training model would rely on the keywords. However, for the review of standard declaration task, excessive reliance on keywords will reduce the classification effect because of ignoring the overall information of the text. Keyword mask pre-training model is proposed. In the fine-tuning stage, the model designs a keyword masking strategy and a keyword blinding strategy. The keyword masking strategy regularizes the BERT model with a mask mechanism, that is, the keywords are reconstructed with other text information except keywords, so that the model focuses on non-keywords information; Keyword blinding strategy makes the model unable to distinguish the categories of text information without contextual text information, which can eliminate the influence of keywords on model decision-making. The experimental results on the real customs declaration data set showing that the method in this thesis exceeds the baseline method in terms of precision and true negative rate.

articleTitle: Research On Virtual Restoration Display Of Chinese Paintings Based On Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In response to the current problem that a large number of broken Chinese paintings cannot be exhibited, an AR restoration method is proposed that allows visitors to experience the restoration process and appreciate the restored works when they visit. Firstly, the damaged Chinese paintings are digitally restored; then the ORB(oriented fast and rotated brief) algorithm extracts more uniform feature points in terms of quantity and distribution through linear transformation image enhancement and improved adaptive thresholding to ensure the accurate overlay of AR virtual content through feature point matching; finally, the color of virtual content is corrected through histogram matching before the virtual-real overlay to ensure the consistency of AR virtual-real fusion. Finally, the color of the virtual content is corrected by histogram matching before the virtual-real superposition to ensure the consistency of AR virtual-real fusion. The experiments show that the method can effectively solve the problem that the broken paintings and calligraphy cannot be exhibited directly and can increase the participation and immersion of visitors.

articleTitle: Design of a dual-loop active hybrid vibration isolation controller
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: It is difficult to maintain the precision of ultra-precision equipment under the interference of vibration and noise, and the performance of the widely used passive control method is limited. This paper proposes a dual-loop active hybrid vibration control (AHVC) based on RBF-RLS adaptive algorithm, which includes a feedback control loop and a feedforward control loop. The integral force feedback (IFF) control loop based on the sky-hook control law is built to effectively reduce the resonance peak of the system, but its time-delay phenomenon restricts the control effect. RLS adaptive feedforward algorithm is used in feedforward control, and RBF neural network is used to identify feedforward model, so as to improve the accuracy of feedforward response. The simulation results show that the amplitude of the resonance peak is reduced by 30.1 dB and the attenuation rate is 96.9% for the vibration isolation system using the dual-loop active hybrid control technology.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation of China's Scientific Data Management Policies Based on The PMC-AE Index Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the process of promoting the open sharing of scientific data management, a standardized and effective scientific data management policy is crucial, which could provide effective theoretical support for the improvement of the scientific data management policy system. To address this problem of imperfect evaluation mechanism and lack of quantitative analysis, we take Chinese scientific data management policies as the research nut. Firstly, we construct an evaluation index system with nine causal variables and a PMC-AE index calculation model, and conduct a more comprehensive evaluation and quantitative analysis of the seven mainstream scientific data management policies in China. The analysis results show that the overall distribution of Chinese scientific data management policies show “national-level-provincial and municipal-level-universities/research institutions”.

articleTitle: Research on A Lightweight Service Mesh Architecture Using eBPF
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Many applications deployed in the cloud are typically refactored as widgets in microservices, and these components run as containers in a Kubernetes environment. The containers then run on clusters of physical servers that interoperate with the data center network. With this deployment, a large number of microservice containers running comes with resource consumption. The prevailing management architecture of microservices deepens this resource consumption on physical servers and increases network latency. We believe that this scenario could be further optimized. In this paper, we argue for an improved service mesh architecture design (compared to the traditional one). It reduces the resource consumption and improves the performance of deployed microservice applications, while providing some end-to-end visibility to debug problems that occur in microservices. We present the design and provide preliminary implementation details using eBPF technology to illustrate the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Noise Covariance Adaptive Federated Filter Based on Variational Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the measurement noise covariance of the navigation measurement components in the integrated navigation system of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in close formation flight is time-varying or difficult to detect accurately, which leads to the decline of filtering accuracy, the zero-reset federated filter is adopted. Different filter calculation periods and fusion periods are designed to fuse the navigation information with unequal intervals. Based on the idea of variational Bayesian inference in the subfilter, the real posterior distribution is approximated by a simple distribution, and the unknown measurement noise covariance is estimated adaptively. The mathematical simulation shows that the algorithm can effectively improve the relative navigation accuracy of UAV formation flight, and can better adapt to the situation of measurement noise covariance mutation.

articleTitle: A Feature Selection Method based on Sparse Regularization Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Data dimensionality reduction is a technology that converts high-dimensional data into low-dimensional data. With the continuous growth of data dimensions, data dimensionality reduction is essential in both industrial applications and scientific research. Feature selection is an effective method to achieve dimensionality reduction. However, most existing feature selection methods can only be applied to small datasets, and they cannot be used in big datasets or have poor performance. In order to overcome this dilemma, A novel feature selection method based on sparse regularization deep neural network, called Sparse Regularization Deep Feature Selection (SRDFS), is proposed. SRDFS utilizes deep neural network and sparse regularization to realize feature selection, which has a good performance on big datasets. In addition, this paper proposes an optimization algorithm based on soft threshold function for sparse regularization. Finally, we compare the proposed method with the related state-of-the-art feature selection methods on six big datasets, and the experimental results show the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Point Cloud Classification Algorithm Considering Local Spatial Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the process of feature extraction of point cloud data, most of the existing methods ignore the rich spatial geometric information in point cloud data, resulting in poor classification accuracy To solve this problem, this paper proposes a point cloud depth learning classification algorithm considering the geometric characteristics of local space The LANet network model is constructed, and a local spatial feature network is proposed to learn the rich spatial geometric relationships in the point cloud data, and the attention mechanism is added to the network to learn the weight of the feature channel on the classification, so as to further improve the accuracy of point cloud classification The simulation experiment on the ModelNet40 classification dataset shows that the local spatial feature learning network can extract complete spatial geometric information, and the attention mechanism can optimize the classification network. Compared with the current mainstream networks, the proposed method can effectively learn point cloud data and help improve the accuracy of point cloud classification.

articleTitle: Comfort assessment of stereo images considering edge objects
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Many people often feel visually uncomfortable when viewing stereo images. In the field of stereo display, it is an important research topic to assess comfort of stereo images accurately. However, the actual stereo image scene is more complex, and it is ineffective to establish the objective comfort assessment model of those images only by few factors. The current related research has shown that edge objects have some impact on visual comfort. Therefore, in order to assessment the visual comfort more accurately, a stereo image comfort assessment model considering edge objects is proposed. The influence of edge objects were analysed, and features of them were analyzed and computed, such as parallax, edge conflict, color and contrast features. In addition, region of interest features were computed by considering the visual characteristics of human eyes. Finally, an objective assessment model of stereo images was constructed by the support vector regression(SVR) algorithm based on the these features. The experimental results had shown that the performance assessment indexes PLCC, SROCC and RMSE are improved by 0.9%, 1.16%, and 10.6%, separately, on the IVY dataset.

articleTitle: Transforming Music Styles with Differentiable Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Thanks to the previous work of Differentiable Digital Signal Processing (DDSP), transferring between timbres becomes much easier and more interpretable. Therefore, the sound sources can be transferred among each other, giving rise to a great variety of applications in the music industry. This project aims to transfer songs among different genres. In this work, we transfer the timbres of traditional Chinese music into other appropriate timbres from a different music genre using DDSP. After that, the separated parts of the songs will be re-combined together and generate the same melody in a different style.

articleTitle: Muscle force estimation in running gait analysis after a prolonged running session via OpenSim
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Using dynamic simulations of movement, researchers can examine neuromuscular coordination, quantify the internal loading of the musculoskeletal system, as well as evaluate athletic performance. OpenSim is a digital modeling software that enables operators to create human models of musculoskeletal structures and simulations of a range of motions. The purpose of the present study was to investigate the muscle force differences before and after a 5 km run in recreational runners. 15 recreational runners joined in this study and underwent 3D running analysis. The lower limb muscle forces of runners were estimated by musculoskeletal modeling based on OpenSim. The results showed that OpenSim muscle force calculations were highly reliable, and that lower limb muscle forces were reduced after long distance running. Further understanding of underlying muscle forces may provide further insight into running biomechanics. The findings provided by this study may help runners plan training programs aimed at increasing muscle strength and enhancing running performance.

articleTitle: Structural parameters of the lower swing arm multiobjective optimization based on the NSGAII genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A multi-objective optimization model was established to improve the forming mechanical properties of the lower swing arm structure by analyzing typical working conditions of an automobile. The model aimed to minimize stress and displacement while optimizing mass. The upper and lower plates of the swing arm, as well as the thickness of the front and rear point bushings, were selected as the design variables.Process parameters were obtained using the Box-Behnken response surface method, and the objective function was calculated through numerical simulation. Combining the Kriging model and NSGAII genetic algorithm, a proxy model was established to map the relationship between design variables and the objective function, leading to optimal results. The results showed a 35% reduction in maximum equivalent stress, a 23.3% reduction in maximum deformation, and a 10<sup>%</sup> reduction in mass of the lower swing arm compared to the original design.

articleTitle: Prediction of key chemical parameters based on improved Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: It is difficult to build accurate prediction models for complex chemical processes with significant nonlinearity and dynamics based on traditional shallow static models. A prediction model based on improved Transformer called CNN-Trans is proposed to address the above challenges. In order to improve the efficiency of Transformer and enhance its local feature extraction capability, the CNN architecture is applied to Transformer's architecture: (1) Dilated causal convolution is used in the embedding layer to obtain multi-scale information and a larger sensory field. (2) Replacing Transformer's feed-forward neural network (FFN) with productive mixed attention (PMA), combining temporal attention and channel attention, significantly reducing model complexity while maintaining performance. (3) The convolution-pooling module is added to the stacking layers of the Encoder to fuse the obtained multi-scale features to obtain finer-grained information. The proposed method was applied to the actual data of PVC drying in a chemical company, and satisfactory results were obtained for the prediction of water content, indicating the feasibility of the proposed method in practical chemical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Implementation of Cellular Automata Based on Memristor
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The cellular automata (CA) is a well-known parallel, biologically inspired computing model. It is based on simple local interaction units (i.e., CA units) and their evolution at any time, resulting in emergent computing, which is suitable for simulating physical system behavior, natural phenomenon prediction and multidimensional problem solutions. In addition, CA is also computationally complete, i.e., it has computational power comparable to that of the von Neumann architecture, so it can be attempted to make next-generation computers. In this paper, the memristor device is considered as the basic module of CA cell circuit implementation, which acts as a combined memory and processing element to implement CA-based circuits. This approach allows for a better implementation of metacellular automata. In particular, as example demonstrations, some applications are presented using 1D and 2D CA arrays based on memristors to demonstrate the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Intelligent System of Badminton Serve Action Based on YOLOv5 and OpenPose
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In badminton matches, players from both sides hit the ball very fast. In peacetime training, coaches and players often need to watch videos repeatedly to capture action information, which leads to the slow efficiency of correcting action. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a method of using YOLOv5 technology for target detection of players and using OpenPose technology to establish a comparative scoring model of serving motion. First, the standard action images of badminton players were shot in professional venues, and the key nodes of all players were marked to initially establish the exclusive data set of badminton matches. Secondly, players with data similarity concentration or fuzzy data are intercepted and trained for many times to obtain a large number of accurate data sets and improve the recognition degree of the model to occluded or fuzzy targets. Finally, through the comparison of the figure service action and standard service action, score from the perspective of difference, judge whether the player's action is standard, so as to guide each player's action. The experimental results show that the badminton analysis model has a more accurate detection effect on the players, greatly shortens the training time, and improves the training efficiency of badminton players.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of the effectiveness of virtual maintenance training for information technology equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The proliferation of advanced technology has ushered in tremendous transformations, and the advancement of IT machinery entails that service personnel possess a higher caliber of competency. In response to the present demands of a certain kind of radar-based virtual maintenance training, a novel virtual maintenance training dynamical evaluation model has been established. By examining the factors that affect evaluation, combined with AHP and FCE, a comprehensive evaluation procedure has been devised to validate and gauge the training efficacy, confirming the model to be efficient and dependable, and laying a robust theoretical basis for virtual maintenance assignments and personnel education.

articleTitle: DLMUSIC: The Improved MUSIC Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation is an important problem in both wireless communication and radar applications. This paper proposes a new algorithm combining deep Learning with multiple signal classification (MUSIC), called DLMUSIC. We use multiple convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to estimate the covariance matrix, and then take the eigenvalue decomposition of the covariance matrix instead of the empirical covariance matrix, meanwhile we use the spatial spectrum approximated by Gaussian function as the label of training data instead of MUSIC spectrum, so our algorithm can overcome many limitations of the MUSIC algorithm which include the inability to localize coherent sources and the poor performance at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Simulation results demonstrate that the DLMUSIC algorithm perform much better than MUSIC algorithm at low SNR with a few snapshots.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Network for Object Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A high-performance re-identification model requires focusing on both the global profile and local details of the object, which means that feature extraction needs to be performed at different granularities of the image. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale network for object re-identification, using the proposed BoT2Net as the backbone and introducing feature pyramid branches after the second and third layers. The feature maps in the bottleneck block of the last layer of BoT2Net are equally divided into four parts according to the number of channels to form the residual structure, and a double-layer self-attention is introduced to capture the global dependent features. Cross-scale connectivity and double-layer self-attention are used within the feature pyramid branches, and finally the importance of weights on channels is judged using a normalization operation. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets show that the method achieves good performance.

articleTitle: 3 D transmission line path optimization method based on particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the accelerating speed of China's economic development, the number of population in the increase, the demand for electricity is also gradually increasing. In addition to the deepening of economic system reform, electric power enterprises have also been rapid development. Among them, the transmission and transformation lines gradually increase the power transmission, which is of great significance to ensure the safety of the masses. In the process of power transmission and transformation line maintenance in electric power enterprises, the traditional maintenance mode mainly adopts the binary variables of 0 and 1, and there are still some deficiencies in the application of particle group algorithm model. Based on this, this study will analyze the 3 D transmission and transformation line path optimization method from the perspective of the particle swarm algorithm, and solve the PSO with the advantage of the particle swarm algorithm. The results suggest that the algorithm has higher efficiency and can better solutions.

articleTitle: Prediction of dissolved oxygen concentration based on improved RBF
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is a directly controlled parameter in the process of sewage treatment. To improve the quality of sewage treatment, A method needs to be found to predict the concentration of dissolved oxygen. This paper presents a new dissolved oxygen concentration prediction model. The water quality factors related to dissolved oxygen in the biological reaction tank were preliminarily screened out for data cleaning, and then the auxiliary variables were further screened by the mutual information rule. Then, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm (GPSO) was used to optimize the radial basis neural network (RBF) parameters, and then the dissolved oxygen concentration in the biological reaction tank was predicted. The RBF model with GPSO has better prediction accuracy than the RBF model based on the traditional PSO algorithm. The determination coefficient (R2) is significantly increased from 0.87 to 0.94, the root mean square error (RMSE) is reduced by 39.53 %, and the mean absolute error (MAE) is reduced by 38.46%. The training results of the proposed dissolved oxygen concentration prediction model in the biological reaction tank show that the established soft measurement model can reasonably and effectively predict the dissolved oxygen concentration in the biological reaction tank.

articleTitle: Remaining Life Prediction Method of Relay Protection Equipment Based on Digital Twin
